data.body: Implemented in local commit 70799436c1c (worktree bug-7c81-argv-creds, from gerrit main 053604a2618), 2026-11-23 PST. Verified before commit: AWS CLI 2.39.7 loads --value file:///dev/stdin (read-only get-parameter probe; request body carried the stdin value). curl -K - sends the expected Basic header and X-Rebar-Token, including for a password containing a double quote and backslash (local one-shot HTTP server). Helpers behave the same under macOS bash 3.2 and bash 5.3. Red check: the extended static guard reports 28 hits on the pre-fix tree (not the 27 the plan estimated) and none after; every service-user.sh and helper behavioural test fails on the pre-fix tree and passes after. Also: the feature-branch-inventory test's curl stub now drains stdin, since curl_auth pipes the config into it under pipefail. First plan review BLOCKED only on description length (9968 > 8000 chars, P4, no LLM pass ran); description shortened, review re-running. make lint, typecheck and the mechanism ratchet exit 0; make verify running. service-user.sh NOT run; nothing rotated.
